Half crouch, hips lower, knees bend naturally and weight stays above feet.
Full compact crouch: deeply bent knees, torso balanced forward, left hand guarding, blade low and safe.
Begin rising from crouch, hips lift and knees partially straighten.
specs.action: CROUCH transition with real knee/hip articulation, not vertical squashing. Feet grounded at stable scale, all armor proportions fixed.

specs.label: saut et réception
phase: Takeoff anticipation: compressed bent knees, hips low, torso leaning toward jump.
Ascending airborne: body extended upward, feet no longer at ground line, knees beginning to tuck.
Descending airborne: knees more tucked, arms balance naturally, blade away from torso.
Grounded landing: feet planted, knees strongly bent absorbing impact, torso stabilized.
specs.action: JUMP / LAND sequence. Clearly distinguish anticipation, ascent, descent and landing; do not merely shift a standing cutout. Whole body must stay within each cell even airborne. Same anatomical scale.

specs.label: garde
phase: Raise guard: left forearm begins crossing chest, right blade arm remains safely forward.
High guard: free left forearm protecting head, right forearm compact at chest, blade not crossing skull.
Brace on block: upper body leans back slightly, shoulders compressed, feet planted, no impact VFX.
Recover stable guard: left forearm returns chest height, weight centered.
specs.action: HIGH GUARD defensive sequence. No attack, shield, added armor or new weapons. Articulated hands and arms, blade never intersects mask or left hand.

specs.label: hurt
phase: First hit reaction: shoulders jerk back, chin lifts slightly behind intact mask, arms recoil.
Peak recoil: torso bends backward at hips, one knee softens, one foot briefly unweights.
Regain balance: forward foot plants, torso begins returning upright, left hand near chest.
Recover stance: knees rebalance, shoulders lower, blade safely aligned with right forearm.
specs.action: NON-GRAPHIC STANDING HURT / RECOVERY. No bleeding, wounds, broken mask or lost equipment. Clearly different articulated recoil poses, no melt/squash or added limbs.

specs.label: attaque légère
phase: Startup: compact anatomical RIGHT forearm draws back beside torso; left hand guards.
Active strike: quick SHORT forward jab/slash with the single right wrist blade extending in forearm axis past empty fist.
Early recovery: right elbow retracts, blade sweeps away from torso, left hand stays guard.
Late recovery: right arm lowered to neutral ready stance, hips square and feet stable.
specs.action: STANDING LIGHT attack using ONE single right wrist blade. No held sword or paired blades; short readable reach wholly inside cell. Draw actual startup/active/early recovery/late recovery.

specs.label: attaque moyenne
phase: Startup: turn hips slightly away, pull right forearm back at waist and bend knees.
Active strike: strong waist-height horizontal right wrist-blade sweep toward opponent, shoulders and hips turning naturally.
Early recovery: sweep ends, right elbow bends, hips return while feet stabilize.
Late recovery: return to upright ready stance with left hand raised and single blade low.
specs.action: STANDING MEDIUM attack: stronger single right wrist-blade body-level slash, anatomically attached to gauntlet throughout. No spin to face away, no new weapon, blade safely within frame.

specs.label: attaque lourde
phase: Startup: bend knees and lift anatomical RIGHT elbow back/up, wrist blade stays aligned with forearm and away from mask.
Active strike: powerful descending diagonal right wrist-blade blow, torso leans into strike, knees anchored.
Early recovery: low follow-through, blade lowered beside lead leg without intersecting it, right elbow begins returning.
Late recovery: rise and reset both shoulders into ready stance, left hand protecting chest.
specs.action: STANDING HEAVY attack: weighty descending single wrist-blade strike. No overhead sword held in hand; the blade is always a rigid extension mounted to the right forearm gauntlet. Four real attack phases, readable distinct silhouette.
